name: Vastus lateralis multiscale anatomy pilot

muscle.registration: Source coordinates retained, translated to local center; no donor microstructure registration

fascicle.registration: Representative cropped segment; no measured placement inside the source muscle

sarcomere.registration: Representative cropped filament lattice, selected dimensions; no donor registration or resolved atomic structures
sarcomere.motion: Symmetric Z-disc and attached thin-filament translation; thick filaments and M line stay fixed. No calcium, ATP, force, titin or cross-bridge state.

fiber.registration: Representative partial myofiber; dimensions are illustrative choices, not donor measurements

visualBrief: Anatomical 3D teaching specimen: realistic bundled longitudinal tissue, selectively opened connective sheaths, clearly visible cut faces, peripheral nuclei, packed striated myofibrils and adjacent capillaries. Restrained warm tissue colors on a dark neutral field. Stable, inspectable semantic structures.
negativeBrief: No cartoon human silhouette, invented clinical tissue measurements, anatomy-as-connectivity claim, decorative blood flow claimed as solved transport, opaque shells concealing every interior, float-scale loss, or paid provider assets.
